pairs.target: xià yìtáng liànxí de qiányìtiān , tǎ wéi xiān xiàng sòng yuǎn wènqīng , zhèhuí bù ná tiě , zhǐ liàn yǒurén cóng shēnhòu jīngguò shí zěnyàng liú lù , lín kē ruò lái , qiántou shífēnzhōng biàn gòu .
pairs.english: The day before the next practice session, Tavi first turned to Song Yuan for clear answers: this time they would not use iron, only practise when someone went by behind him, learning how to leave room; if Lin Ke came, the first ten minutes would be enough.
pairs.hanzi: 下一堂练习的前一天，塔维先向宋远问清，这回不拿铁，只练有人从身后经过时怎样留路，林珂若来，前头十分钟便够。

pairs.target: tā tóng sòng yuǎn yídào chūmén , zài láng xià zhǎodào lín kē , jiāng huà shuō quán , tā wèn zìjǐ néng bunéng yě shì , sòng yuǎn shuō kěyǐ , zǒu mànxiē , bù lán rén , bù jiē dǎ , tā zhè cái dāying .
pairs.english: He went out together with Song Yuan, found Lin Ke in the corridor and explained the whole arrangement; she asked whether she could try too, and Song Yuan said yes: walk slowly, do not block anyone, do not take blows; only then did she agree.
pairs.hanzi: 他同宋远一道出门，在廊下找到林珂，将话说全，她问自己能不能也试，宋远说可以，走慢些，不拦人，不接打，她这才答应。

pairs.target: dào le yuē hǎo de bàngwǎn , tā dài zhe zìyòng de hùdiàn lái , xiān jiāng duǎn biàn sāijìn lǐngkǒu , wèn shífēnzhōng cóng tāmen shuōhuà suàn , háishì cóng zuòxià suàn .
pairs.english: On the appointed evening she came with her own protective pads, first tucking her short braid into her collar, and asked whether the ten minutes counted from their talking or from sitting down.
pairs.hanzi: 到了约好的傍晚，她带着自用的护垫来，先将短辫塞进领口，问十分钟从他们说话算，还是从坐下算。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn ràng tā cóng zuòxià suàn , tǎ wéi bān lái gāo dèng , bǎ zuǒjiǎo fàngdào búbì shēn wān de wèizhì , xī shàng píngdì yǐ bù téng , dūn shēn le réng huì qiān .
pairs.english: Song Yuan let her count from sitting down; Tavi brought a high stool and placed his left foot where it need not bend deeply; his knee no longer hurt on level ground, but a deep crouch would still pull.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远让她从坐下算，塔维搬来高凳，把左脚放到不必深弯的位置，膝上平地已不疼，蹲深了仍会牵。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī méi sòng tiě lái , jīnrì yòng de dōu zhǐshì pǔtōng mù jù , tǎ wéi wò duǎn dùn , lín kē xiān kōngshǒu , sòng yuǎn de cháng bàngtóu bāo le hòu bù .
pairs.english: Teacher Vey had sent no iron over; today all they used was only ordinary wooden equipment; Tavi gripped a short shield, Lin Ke began empty-handed, and Song Yuan had his long staff tip wrapped in thick cloth.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师没送铁来，今日用的都只是普通木具，塔维握短盾，林珂先空手，宋远的长棒头包了厚布。

pairs.target: tāmen chuān hǎo hùdiàn , sòng yuǎn zài dìshàng bǎi liǎngtiáo xìshéng , gé chū dèng hòu yìtiáo guò dào , shuō zìjǐ cóngqián tou mànzǒu , qīngdiǎn hùdiàn biàn tíng , bù zhuī dìèr xià .
pairs.english: They put on the protective pads; Song Yuan laid two thin cords on the ground to mark a passage behind the stool, saying he would walk slowly from the front and stop at a light touch to a pad, without following with a second strike.
pairs.hanzi: 他们穿好护垫，宋远在地上摆两条细绳，隔出凳后一条过道，说自己从前头慢走，轻点护垫便停，不追第二下。

pairs.target: lín kē yào cóng tǎ wéi shēnhòu zǒu guòqù , bùnéng tuīkāi tā , tǎ wéi yě bùnéng zhàn qǐ zhuī bàng , dìshàng de shéng zhǐ zuò biān , bùkě ná jiǎo cǎizhù .
pairs.english: Lin Ke was to walk past behind Tavi, without pushing him aside; Tavi too must not stand up to pursue the staff; the cords on the ground served only as boundaries and must not be pinned with a foot.
pairs.hanzi: 林珂要从塔维身后走过去，不能推开他，塔维也不能站起追棒，地上的绳只作边，不可拿脚踩住。

pairs.target: dìyīhuí sòng yuǎn gāng xiàng yòuyí , tǎ wéi biàn jiāng dùn biān zhuǎnguò qù , dùn xià nà zhī shǒu què wǎnghòu zhāng , zhèng dǎngzhù lín kē yào zǒu de dìfāng .
pairs.english: On the first attempt Song Yuan had just moved right when Tavi turned the shield edge toward him, but the hand beneath it spread backward, directly blocking the place Lin Ke needed to walk through.
pairs.hanzi: 第一回宋远刚向右移，塔维便将盾边转过去，盾下那只手却往后张，正挡住林珂要走的地方。

pairs.target: tā zài tā shēnhòu tíngzhù , sòng yuǎn de bàng yě tíng le , sāngè rén shuí dōu méi pèngdào shuí , tǎ wéi huítóu cái fāxiànzìjǐ de shǒu jīhū zhǐzhe tā dùzi .
pairs.english: She stopped at his back, and Song Yuan's staff stopped too; none of the three touched anyone, and only on turning did Tavi discover that his own hand was pointing almost at her belly.
pairs.hanzi: 她在他身后停住，宋远的棒也停了，三个人谁都没碰到谁，塔维回头才发现自己的手几乎指着她肚子。

pairs.target: " nǐ jiào wǒ cóng zhèér guò , háishì jiào wǒ zhàn zhe kàn ? "
pairs.english: “Are you asking me to pass through here, or asking me to stand and watch?”
pairs.hanzi: “你叫我从这儿过，还是叫我站着看？”

pairs.target: lín kē méiyǒu rào dào shéng wài , tǎ wéi jiāng shǒu shōuhuí lái , liǎn yǒuxiē rè , shuō zài lái , tā què jiào tā xiān kànkàn dùn , fāngcái tā yě kuài zhuǎn dào bèihòu le .
pairs.english: Lin Ke did not circle outside the cord; Tavi drew his hand back, his face a little hot, and said to try again, but she told him first to look at the shield: just now it had nearly turned behind him too.
pairs.hanzi: 林珂没有绕到绳外，塔维将手收回来，脸有些热，说再来，她却叫他先看看盾，方才它也快转到背后了。

pairs.target: tā dītóu , jiāng dùn shōu zhèng , zuǒshǒu gē jìn shēnpáng , sòng yuǎn chóngxīn zhàn yuǎn yìdiǎn , děng lín kē shuōhǎo le , cái cóng lìngyícè mànmàn kào guòlái .
pairs.english: He lowered his head, straightened the shield and rested his left hand close to his side; Song Yuan stood a little farther away again, waiting until Lin Ke said she was ready before slowly approaching from the other side.
pairs.hanzi: 他低头，将盾收正，左手搁近身旁，宋远重新站远一点，等林珂说好了，才从另一侧慢慢靠过来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhèhuí méiyǒu fēng zhù hòulù , wàngjiàn lín kē jiāntóu cóng pángbiān jīngguò , shǒu què jí zhe gēnzhe nà diǎn yǐngzi zhuǎn , bàngtóu biàn cóng dùn yán xià qīngdiǎn dào yāo diàn .
pairs.english: This time Tavi did not block the route behind; seeing Lin Ke's shoulder pass beside him, his hand hurried to turn after that glimpse, but the staff tip then lightly touched his waist pad from under the shield rim.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维这回没有封住后路，望见林珂肩头从旁边经过，手却急着跟着那点影子转，棒头便从盾沿下轻点到腰垫。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn dāngjí chè kāi , lín kē yě tíngbù , tǎ wéi xiān mō le yíxià yāo cè , gé zhe diàn zhǐ jué dào yìdiǎn tuī , xīnlǐ què bǐ bèi tuī de zhòng shí hái àonǎo .
pairs.english: Song Yuan withdrew immediately, and Lin Ke stopped too; Tavi first briefly felt his waist, sensing only a slight push through the padding, yet he was even more frustrated than when being shoved hard.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远当即撤开，林珂也停步，塔维先摸了一下腰侧，隔着垫只觉到一点推，心里却比被推得重时还懊恼。

pairs.target: tā fāngcái ruò yǒu tiě , yòubiān méi nàme tuìràng , shìbushì biàn dǎngzhù le , huà shuō dào bànjù , zìjǐ xiān wànglewàng tiē zài mùbǐng shàng de shǒu .
pairs.english: If he had had iron just now, with less yielding on the right, would that have blocked it; halfway through saying this, he himself first looked at his hand there, pressed on the wooden grip.
pairs.hanzi: 他方才若有铁，右边没那么退让，是不是便挡住了，话说到半句，自己先望了望贴在木柄上的手。

pairs.target: " lìngyìbiān ne ? "
pairs.english: “And the other side?”
pairs.hanzi: “另一边呢？”

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn méiyǒu jiào tā dá yǐjīng liàn guò dehuà , zhǐ jiāng kōng mù tuō fàngzài dèng biān , tǎ wéi kànjiàn tā , cái fāxiànzìjǐ xiǎng de zhǐyǒu yǎnqián zhèyíxià .
pairs.english: Song Yuan did not make him answer with words already practised, only placed an empty wooden carrier beside the stool; Tavi saw it and only then realised that what he was thinking about was just this single moment before him.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远没有叫他答已经练过的话，只将空木托放在凳边，塔维看见它，才发现自己想的只有眼前这一下。

pairs.target: tā ruò liǎng zhǎng dōu tiēzhe , shēnhòu nàge rén cóng nǎbiān guò , zìjǐ de shǒubì liúzài nǎér , tā hái méi shì guò , gèng méiyǒu yìbiān chè zhǎng yìbiān jiēxià yí bàng de běnshì .
pairs.english: If he kept both palms in contact, which way would the person behind him pass, and where would his own arms stay; he had not tried that yet, much less had the ability to take the next staff strike while withdrawing a palm.
pairs.hanzi: 他若两掌都贴着，身后那个人从哪边过，自己的手臂留在哪儿，他还没试过，更没有一边撤掌一边接下一棒的本事。

pairs.target: lín kē wānyāo shíqǐ piāndiào de shéng , wèn tā hái lái bu lái , tā zhǐ shèng yìhuí de gōngfū , dàihuìer yào huíjiā tìrén sòng dēngzhào .
pairs.english: Lin Ke bent to pick up the displaced cord and asked whether he still wanted a try; she had time for only one more attempt and would soon need to go home to deliver a lampshade for someone.
pairs.hanzi: 林珂弯腰拾起偏掉的绳，问他还来不来，她只剩一回的工夫，待会儿要回家替人送灯罩。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yuán xiǎng zài kàn nà zhī mù tuō , tīngjiàn tā shuō dēngzhào , biàn jiāng tā tuī yuǎn yìdiǎn , shuōlái , zhèhuí xiān gàosù zìjǐ tā cóng nǎbiān zǒu .
pairs.english: Tavi had meant to look again at that wooden carrier, but on hearing her mention a lampshade, he pushed it a little farther away and said yes, this time first tell him which side she would walk along.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维原想再看那只木托，听见她说灯罩，便将它推远一点，说来，这回先告诉自己她从哪边走。

pairs.target: tā zhǐ zuǒbiān , sòng yuǎn bú huàn huāyàng , réng cóng gāngcái nà yícè lái , tǎ wéi xiān kànqīng dùn yán yǔ shéng zhījiān nà yìdiǎn dìfāng , méi jí zhe yíngshàngqù .
pairs.english: She indicated the left; Song Yuan changed no tactics, coming from that same side as before; Tavi first saw clearly the little space between the shield rim and the cord, without hurrying to meet him.
pairs.hanzi: 她指左边，宋远不换花样，仍从刚才那一侧来，塔维先看清盾沿与绳之间那一点地方，没急着迎上去。

pairs.target: bàngtóu yā dào dùn miàn , tā jiānshàng wǎnghòu suō le yíxià , zuǒjiǎo méiyǒu luàn nuó , lín kē de jiǎobù zài shēnhòu guòqù , tā tīngjiàn yīliào cā guò dèng jiǎo de shēngyīn .
pairs.english: The staff tip pressed onto the shield face; his shoulder drew back a little, his left foot did not shift wildly, and Lin Ke's footsteps passed at his back; he heard the sound of fabric brushing the stool's corner.
pairs.hanzi: 棒头压到盾面，他肩上往后缩了一下，左脚没有乱挪，林珂的脚步在身后过去，他听见衣料擦过凳角的声音。

pairs.target: zhè yìhuí tā guò le , sòng yuǎn méi diǎn dào yāo diàn , dùn biān què yāzhù tǎ wéi de xiùkǒu , jiào tā xiǎng jiāng shǒu fàng dī shí kǎ le yíxià , zhǐhǎo xiān jiàotíng .
pairs.english: This time she got past and Song Yuan did not touch the waist pad, but the shield edge trapped Tavi's cuff, catching for a moment when he tried to lower his hand, so he had to call a stop first.
pairs.hanzi: 这一回她过了，宋远没点到腰垫，盾边却压住塔维的袖口，叫他想将手放低时卡了一下，只好先叫停。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn chè bàng , ràng tā zìjǐ jiěkāi , lín kē zǒu huílái kàn , shuō tājiā de dēngzhào ruò guà zài tā zhèér , bànlù jiù děi chāixiàlái jiùrén .
pairs.english: Song Yuan withdrew the staff and let him free himself; Lin Ke walked back to look, saying that if her household's lampshade hung on him here, they would have to dismantle it halfway to rescue someone.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远撤棒，让他自己解开，林珂走回来看，说她家的灯罩若挂在他这儿，半路就得拆下来救人。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào le yìshēng , shǒu cóng xiùlǐ tuō chūlái , xiān kàn wànshàng méiyǒu cā hóng , zài bǎ diàn jiěkāi , xīgài yě méi bǐ zuòxià qián duō téng .
pairs.english: Tavi gave a laugh and slipped his hand out of the sleeve, first checked that his wrist was not rubbed red, then unfastened the pad; his knee too hurt no more than before he sat down.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑了一声，手从袖里脱出来，先看腕上没有擦红，再把垫解开，膝盖也没比坐下前多疼。

pairs.target: lín kē de shífēnzhōng yǐ guò , tā shōu hǎo hùjù , méi yīn zuìhòu zhè yìhuí zǒu tōng jiù duō liú , tǎ wéi tì tā jiāngmén lākāi , zìjǐ méi qiǎng zhe gēn chūqù .
pairs.english: Lin Ke's ten minutes had passed; she packed her protective gear, not staying longer because that last attempt worked; Tavi pulled the door open for her without rushing to follow her out himself.
pairs.hanzi: 林珂的十分钟已过，她收好护具，没因最后这一回走通就多留，塔维替她将门拉开，自己没抢着跟出去。

pairs.target: " xiàhuí hái jiào nǐ ? "
pairs.english: “Shall I ask you again next time?”
pairs.hanzi: “下回还叫你？”

pairs.target: tā kàn yìyǎn dèng biān nà liǎngtiáo shéng , shuō xiān bǎ xiùkǒu shōu hǎo , zǒu dào láng xià yòu bǔ le yíjù , zhēn pái dào nǎ tiān , zǎodiǎn lái wèn , biétì tā kòng zhe .
pairs.english: She glanced at the two cords beside the stool, saying first to tuck his cuff away, then walked into the corridor and added that once a day was actually arranged, he should ask early rather than keep it free on her behalf.
pairs.hanzi: 她看一眼凳边那两条绳，说先把袖口收好，走到廊下又补了一句，真排到哪天，早点来问，别替她空着。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn zài wūlǐ děng tā , tǎ wéi huíqù bǎ dùn guà hǎo , méiyǒu jiāng gāngcái nà yíxià xiěchéng néng hù rén , zhǐ huà le dèngzi hé cóng zuǒbiān guòqù de yì shuāngjiǎo .
pairs.english: Song Yuan waited for him in the room; Tavi went back and hung the shield up, without recording that moment just now as being able to protect someone, only drawing the stool and a pair of feet passing from the left.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远在屋里等他，塔维回去把盾挂好，没有将刚才那一下写成能护人，只画了凳子和从左边过去的一双脚。

pairs.target: huà dào zìjǐ de zuǒshǒu , tā jiāng bǐ tíng le yíhuìer , lìng ná yìzhāng zhǐ , bǎ liǎngzhī mù tuō de jùlí yě liú le chūlái .
pairs.english: On reaching his own left hand in the drawing, he paused his pen a while, took another sheet of paper, and left room for the distance between the two wooden carriers as well.
pairs.hanzi: 画到自己的左手，他将笔停了一会儿，另拿一张纸，把两只木托的距离也留了出来。
